nodes.label: Graphify
nodes.rationale: Builds persistent, auditable knowledge graphs from mixed corpora.

nodes.label: URL Ingestion and Folder Watch
nodes.rationale: URLs become corpus files; watched code rebuilds automatically while semantic changes request an update.

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction Contract
nodes.rationale: Requires deterministic full-path IDs, verbatim source paths, strict file types, and auditable confidence scores.

nodes.label: GitHub and Cross-Repository Merge
nodes.rationale: Repositories are extracted separately and merged with origin metadata.

nodes.label: Automatic Graph Hooks
nodes.rationale: Post-commit and Claude integrations keep code graphs available and current.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Navigation
nodes.rationale: Queries expand only from graph vocabulary before BFS, DFS, path, or explain traversal.

nodes.label: Graph Work Memory
nodes.rationale: Saved outcomes, corrections, preferred sources, and dead ends improve later sessions.

nodes.label: Whisper Media Transcription
nodes.rationale: Audio and video become domain-hinted document transcripts before semantic extraction.

nodes.label: Incremental Re-Extraction
nodes.rationale: Changed sources replace old content, deleted sources are pruned, and only successful semantic extraction is stamped.

nodes.label: Existing Graph Fast Path
nodes.rationale: Codebase questions query an existing graph instead of rebuilding it.

nodes.label: Structural and Semantic Extraction Pipeline
nodes.rationale: AST extraction handles code deterministically while agents interpret documents, papers, and images.

nodes.label: Graphify Project Instructions
nodes.rationale: Existing graph queries precede broad source browsing and code changes require graph updates.

nodes.label: CoCreate
nodes.rationale: A local-first collaborative canvas preserves authorship while one serialized builder produces a shared React product.

nodes.label: Generated Project Sandbox
nodes.rationale: Validated frontend-only operations, compile-before-promotion, and isolated storage preserve the last working Product.

nodes.label: Provider Capability and Credential Security
nodes.rationale: Provider contracts are checked separately and owner-managed credentials are encrypted and never returned to collaborators.
